question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a green ball, Bob has a white ball, Claire has a purple ball, Dave has a red ball, Eve has a silver ball, Fred has a grey ball, and Gertrude has a gold ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Gertrude and Dave swap balls. Then, Fred and Claire swap balls. Then, Alice and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Fred swap balls. Then, Alice and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Bob and Claire swap balls. Finally, Alice and Eve swap balls. At the end of the game, Claire has the
Options:
(A) green ball
(B) white ball
(C) purple ball
(D) red ball
(E) silver ball
(F) grey ball
(G) gold ball
solution:
Each row lists ball colors in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: green, white, purple, red, silver, grey, gold
1. Gertrude ↔ Dave: green, white, purple, gold, silver, grey, red
2. Fred ↔ Claire: green, white, grey, gold, silver, purple, red
3. Alice ↔ Gertrude: red, white, grey, gold, silver, purple, green
4. Gertrude ↔ Fred: red, white, grey, gold, silver, green, purple
5. Alice ↔ Gertrude: purple, white, grey, gold, silver, green, red
6. Bob ↔ Claire: purple, grey, white, gold, silver, green, red
7. Alice ↔ Eve: silver, grey, white, gold, purple, green, red
Claire has the white ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
